home.seoTitle: Les Mielleries — Pure, natural honey from Cameroon
home.seoDesc: Cameroon's leading honey packer and exporter. Savannah honey, mountain and forest honey, PGI Oku white honey, beeswax and propolis.
home.lead: Raw honeys sourced from beekeepers across Cameroon's three main beekeeping regions. Filtered, never processed.
home.manifesto: It all began in 2000, with a group of beekeepers. Twenty-five years later, we remain true to the same belief: honey deserves respect. We harvest it far from cities, we filter it without heating it, and we pay our beekeepers the price we agree on together. Because fair honey starts with a fair partnership.
home.terroirLead: Hives are set far from cities and industrial areas, in a healthy environment.

regions.name: Savannah
regions.text: Generous amber honeys, born from sun-drenched flora.

regions.name: Mount Oku
regions.text: The rare Oku white honey, protected by a Geographical Indication.

home.rangeTitle: Honeys that tell the story of a region
home.foodText: In tea, coffee, herbal tea, or as a drink with water and lemon. As a sweetener in doughnuts, bread and cakes. It is also used in biscuits, cereals, yoghurts, mead, wines and liqueurs.
home.traditionText: Used since time immemorial for its virtues: it soothes the throat, provides natural energy and helps in times of fatigue. It is traditionally associated with well-being and recovery.
home.benefitsNote: Honey is not a substitute for medical advice. Not suitable for children under one year old.
home.proTitle: Cameroon's leading honey packer and exporter
home.proText: Food industry, distributors, hospitality, cosmetics: we supply our honeys in drums and jerrycans and our beeswax in 22 kg blocks, in Cameroon and in more than 5 countries.
home.finalText: Our team replies directly on WhatsApp.

story.seoDesc: From a beekeepers' group in 2000 to a limited company in 2011: the story, mission and values of Les Mielleries.
story.title: Twenty-five years serving Cameroonian honey
story.lead: Les Mielleries is the fruit of the dedication, patience and environmental and social commitment of its founder, Jacques Georges Badjang.

timeline.title: A beekeepers' group
timeline.text: A Community Interest Group (GIC) of beekeepers is founded.

timeline.title: The company is born
timeline.text: The group becomes Les Mielleries Sarl and structures the supply chain: collection, filtering, packing.

timeline.title: National leader
timeline.text: Cameroon's leading honey packer and exporter, present in more than 5 countries.

story.suppliersText: Most of our honey comes from producers organised in groups and cooperatives spread across Cameroon's three main beekeeping regions, as well as independent producers affiliated with our network.
story.missionText: To go beyond production: processing (filtering) and transforming hive products before sale, to supply quality products to Cameroonian and foreign markets, with the best conditions of cost, lead time and reliability.

values.title: Respect for customers
values.text: Products that meet their needs, under optimal conditions.

values.title: Valued partners
values.text: Shareholders, suppliers, banks, the State: relationships built on trust.

values.title: Respected teams
values.text: A working environment that supports everyone's physical and mental health.

values.title: Fair trade
values.text: Purchase prices agreed jointly with beekeepers, and support to improve their production methods.

story.quote: Regular honey consumption is a credible alternative for balanced meals in Cameroonian households.

products.seoDesc: Multifloral and monofloral honeys, PGI Oku white honey, honey sticks, beeswax, propolis and bulk supply for professionals.
products.title: All the richness of the hive
products.lead: We produce a wide selection of the finest honeys to always guarantee the best quality: around 300 tonnes of natural honey and 200 tonnes of beeswax a year.
products.packaging: Packed in jars, bottles, jerrycans and drums.
